test.create_query: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS {database}
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {database}.evo_add

CREATE TABLE {database}.evo_add (l_orderkey Int32, l_quantity Float64) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/evo_add_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet')
INSERT INTO {database}.evo_add SELECT l_orderkey, l_quantity FROM tpch10.lineitem LIMIT 100000 SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1
ALTER TABLE {database}.evo_add ADD COLUMN l_note Nullable(String)
INSERT INTO {database}.evo_add SELECT l_orderkey, l_quantity, l_comment FROM tpch10.lineitem LIMIT 100000, 100000 SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1
test.query: SELECT count(), countIf(l_note IS NULL) FROM {database}.evo_add
test.create_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {database}.evo_drop

CREATE TABLE {database}.evo_drop (l_orderkey Int32, l_quantity Float64, l_comment String) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/evo_drop_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet')
INSERT INTO {database}.evo_drop SELECT l_orderkey, l_quantity, l_comment FROM tpch10.lineitem LIMIT 100000 SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1
ALTER TABLE {database}.evo_drop DROP COLUMN l_comment
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {database}.evo_rename

CREATE TABLE {database}.evo_rename (l_orderkey Int32, l_quantity Float64) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/evo_rename_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet')
INSERT INTO {database}.evo_rename SELECT l_orderkey, l_quantity FROM tpch10.lineitem LIMIT 100000 SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1
ALTER TABLE {database}.evo_rename RENAME COLUMN l_quantity TO qty
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {database}.part_identity

CREATE TABLE {database}.part_identity (l_orderkey Int32, l_returnflag String, l_extendedprice Float64) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/part_identity_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet') PARTITION BY (l_returnflag)
INSERT INTO {database}.part_identity SELECT l_orderkey, l_returnflag, l_extendedprice FROM tpch10.lineitem LIMIT 200000 SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(l_extendedprice) FROM {database}.part_identity WHERE l_returnflag = 'R'
test.create_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {database}.part_bucket

CREATE TABLE {database}.part_bucket (l_orderkey Int32, l_quantity Float64) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/part_bucket_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet') PARTITION BY (icebergBucket(16, l_orderkey))
INSERT INTO {database}.part_bucket SELECT l_orderkey, l_quantity FROM tpch10.lineitem LIMIT 200000 SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(l_quantity) FROM {database}.part_bucket WHERE l_orderkey = 12345678
test.create_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {database}.part_month

CREATE TABLE {database}.part_month (l_orderkey Int32, l_shipdate Date, l_quantity Float64) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/part_month_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet') PARTITION BY (toMonthNumSinceEpoch(l_shipdate))

INSERT INTO {database}.part_month SELECT l_orderkey, l_shipdate, l_quantity FROM tpch10.lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= toDate('1994-01-01') AND l_shipdate < toDate('1995-01-01') LIMIT 200000 SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(l_quantity) FROM {database}.part_month WHERE l_shipdate >= toDate('1994-06-01') AND l_shipdate < toDate('1994-07-01')
test.create_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {database}.upd_part

CREATE TABLE {database}.upd_part (l_orderkey Int32, l_returnflag String, l_quantity Float64) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/upd_part_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet') PARTITION BY (l_returnflag)
INSERT INTO {database}.upd_part SELECT l_orderkey, l_returnflag, l_quantity FROM tpch10.lineitem LIMIT 200000 SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1
test.query: ALTER TABLE {database}.upd_part UPDATE l_returnflag = 'X' WHERE l_orderkey % 5 = 0
test.create_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {database}.sorted_li

CREATE TABLE {database}.sorted_li (l_orderkey Int32, l_shipdate Date, l_extendedprice Float64) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/sorted_li_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet') ORDER BY (l_shipdate, l_orderkey)

INSERT INTO {database}.sorted_li SELECT l_orderkey, l_shipdate, l_extendedprice FROM tpch10.lineitem LIMIT 500000 SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, iceberg_insert_max_rows_in_data_file = 50000
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(l_extendedprice) FROM {database}.sorted_li WHERE l_shipdate BETWEEN toDate('1994-06-01') AND toDate('1994-06-30')
test.create_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {database}.nested_t

CREATE TABLE {database}.nested_t (id Int64, tags Array(String), props Map(String, Int64), rec Tuple(a Int64, b String)) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/nested_t_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet')
INSERT INTO {database}.nested_t SELECT number, [toString(number), 'x'], map('k', number), (number, toString(number)) FROM numbers(200000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(length(tags)), sum(props['k']), sum(rec.1) FROM {database}.nested_t
